AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block specifies heat treatment as '28-32 HRC' while note N3 specifies '24-32 HRC', creating a conflict about the required hardness range. The designer must align these two values so the heat treater knows which specification to follow.","recommended_correction":"Update either the title block or note N3 so both state the same hardness range."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D9","page":1,"quote":"30±0.1"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimension D9 carries a tolerance band of 0.2 mm on a part that is zinc plated, but no allowance is made for plating thickness. Without accounting for the coating buildup, the finished dimension may fall outside the ±0.1 tolerance and cause assembly interference. The designer should reduce the pre-plating nominal size or add a note specifying the maximum allowable plating thickness on this feature.","recommended_correction":"Adjust the pre-plate dimension or add a plating-thickness allowance note for the feature controlled by D9."}]}
